business_summary.text: Bluspring Enterprises Limited is an integrated infrastructure services company with segments in facility and food services, security services, and smart infra, energy, and engineering. The company has recently acquired STEAG Energy Services and is in the process of acquiring LSG Sky Chefs India to expand its service offerings.

lab.quote: So there is an organic growth as we've demonstrated last year, you know, we've done a double-digit growth. So from our organic businesses, we expect a 14% to 15% growth.

call_memory.quote: So there is an organic growth as we've demonstrated last year, you know, we've done a double-digit growth. So from our organic businesses, we expect a 14% to 15% growth.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Bluspring expects an organic growth of 14% to 15% from its existing businesses in FY27.

lab.quote: And with this acquisition, our internal estimate is that we should definitely be in the touching distance of 5% margins.

call_memory.quote: And with this acquisition, our internal estimate is that we should definitely be in the touching distance of 5% margins.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Bluspring expects EBITDA margins to reach touching distance of 5% following the STEAG acquisition.

lab.quote: Coming to the acquisitions that we announced recently, the acquisitions of STEAG India is expected to add nearly 20% to our top line and improve our pro forma EBITDA margins for the year by approximately 90 basis to 100 basis points.

call_memory.quote: Coming to the acquisitions that we announced recently, the acquisitions of STEAG India is expected to add nearly 20% to our top line and improve our pro forma EBITDA margins for the year by approximately 90 basis to 100 basis points.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: STEAG acquisition is expected to add nearly 20% to Bluspring's top line and improve pro forma EBITDA margins for the year by approximately 90 basis to 100 basis points.

lab.quote: STEAG operates at high-single digit EBITDA margins. So at INR 700 crores of revenue, you know, let's say around INR 60 crores to INR 65 crores of annualized EBITDA should come from STEAG.

call_memory.quote: STEAG operates at high-single digit EBITDA margins. So at INR 700 crores of revenue, you know, let's say around INR 60 crores to INR 65 crores of annualized EBITDA should come from STEAG.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: STEAG is expected to add around INR 60 crores to INR 65 crores of annualized EBITDA at high-single digit EBITDA margins on INR 700 crores of revenue.

lab.quote: LSG operates close to around 17% to 18% presently operating margins. And with INR110 crores of revenue, they should probably add another INR 20 crores of EBITDA from LSG operations.

call_memory.quote: LSG operates close to around 17% to 18% presently operating margins. And with INR110 crores of revenue, they should probably add another INR 20 crores of EBITDA from LSG operations.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: LSG operates at 17% to 18% operating margins and should add another INR 20 crores of EBITDA from its INR 110 crores revenue.

lab.quote: On a profit after-tax, we believe with both these operations integrated well both financially as well as culturally, we should cross on an annualized basis a INR 100 crores PAT company with both these acquisitions integrated well.

call_memory.quote: On a profit after-tax, we believe with both these operations integrated well both financially as well as culturally, we should cross on an annualized basis a INR 100 crores PAT company with both these acquisitions integrated well.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Bluspring expects to cross an annualized PAT of INR 100 crores ex of foundit once both acquisitions are integrated well.

lab.quote: This is in line with our commitment to be EBITDA profitable by end of this financial year.

call_memory.quote: This is in line with our commitment to be EBITDA profitable by end of this financial year.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Bluspring is committed to make foundit EBITDA profitable by the end of this financial year.

lab.quote: So starting Q1, we'll start consolidating STEAG with Bluspring. And as far as LSG acquisitions, we are looking at a timelines of another 30 to 45 days within which we assume the acquisitions to get completed.

call_memory.quote: So starting Q1, we'll start consolidating STEAG with Bluspring. And as far as LSG acquisitions, we are looking at a timelines of another 30 to 45 days within which we assume the acquisitions to get completed.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: STEAG acquisition is expected to close within this week.

lab.quote: Revenue for FY26 grew 11% year-on-year to INR 3,304 crores, while Q4 revenue increased 8% year-on-year to INR 846 crores.

call_memory.quote: Revenue for FY26 grew 11% year-on-year to INR 3,304 crores, while Q4 revenue increased 8% year-on-year to INR 846 crores.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Bluspring's revenue for FY26 grew 11% year-on-year to INR 3,304 crores, while Q4 revenue increased 8% year-on-year to INR 846 crores.

lab.quote: EBITDA for FY26 increased by 10% year-on-year to INR 121 crores.

call_memory.quote: EBITDA for FY26 increased by 10% year-on-year to INR 121 crores.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: EBITDA for FY26 increased by 10% year-on-year to INR 121 crores.

lab.quote: Q4 EBITDA margin crossed 4% benchmark, reaching 4.2%, a 35 basis points quarter-on-quarter increase.

call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Q4 EBITDA margin reached 4.2%, a 35 basis points quarter-on-quarter increase.

lab.quote: Profit after-tax, adjusted for the one-time impact of new Labour Code related changes, grew 26% year-on-year to INR 67 crores.

call_memory.quote: Profit after-tax, adjusted for the one-time impact of new Labour Code related changes, grew 26% year-on-year to INR 67 crores.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Profit after-tax, adjusted for the one-time impact of new Labour Code related changes, grew 26% year-on-year to INR 67 crores for FY26.

lab.quote: FY26 revenue stood at INR 2,031 crores, up 12% year-on-year, while Q4 revenue grew 10% year-on-year to INR 519 crores.

call_memory.quote: FY26 revenue stood at INR 2,031 crores, up 12% year-on-year, while Q4 revenue grew 10% year-on-year to INR 519 crores.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Facility and Food services FY26 revenue stood at INR 2,031 crores, up 12% year-on-year.

lab.quote: FY26 revenue for telecom and industrial grew 7% year-on-year to INR 615 crores.

call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Telecom and industrial FY26 revenue grew 7% year-on-year to INR 615 crores.

lab.quote: The business clocked FY26 revenues of INR 659 crores, an increase of 14% year-on-year.

call_memory.quote: The business clocked FY26 revenues of INR 659 crores, an increase of 14% year-on-year.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Security Services recorded FY26 revenues of INR 659 crores, an increase of 14% year-on-year.

lab.quote: The sales velocity has jumped by 50% from an average sale of INR 17 crores during the first three quarters of FY26 to INR 26 crores in Q4 FY26.

call_memory.quote: The sales velocity has jumped by 50% from an average sale of INR 17 crores during the first three quarters of FY26 to INR 26 crores in Q4 FY26.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: foundit sales velocity jumped by 50% from an average sale of INR 17 crores during the first three quarters of FY26 to INR 26 crores in Q4 FY26.

lab.quote: In line with our recent guidance, we have lowered our EBITDA losses from INR 12 crores in Q3 to INR 9 crores in Q4 FY26.

call_memory.quote: In line with our recent guidance, we have lowered our EBITDA losses from INR 12 crores in Q3 to INR 9 crores in Q4 FY26.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: foundit EBITDA losses came down from INR 12 crores in Q3 to INR 9 crores in Q4 FY26.

lab.quote: Exceptional item during the quarter was INR 6.8 crores. This was on account of certain costs relating to professional fees which we incurred for the acquisitions announced recently.

call_memory.quote: Exceptional item during the quarter was INR 6.8 crores. This was on account of certain costs relating to professional fees which we incurred for the acquisitions announced recently.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Exceptional item during the quarter was INR 6.8 crores on account of professional fees incurred for recent acquisitions.

lab.quote: We are happy to report that we stand at a net cash position of INR 15 crores as of March 2026.

call_memory.quote: We are happy to report that we stand at a net cash position of INR 15 crores as of March 2026.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Bluspring stands at a net cash position of INR 15 crores as of March 2026.

lab.quote: Our working capital days for the year stood at 37 days as compared to 46 days a year back.

call_memory.quote: Our working capital days for the year stood at 37 days as compared to 46 days a year back.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Working capital days for the year stood at 37 days as compared to 46 days a year back.

call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT

operating_notes.text: Subsidiary BNHOPL secured a ₹175 Cr term loan from Poonawalla Fincorp to acquire STEAG Energy Services (India).
STEAG Energy Services India acquisition announced for an all-cash equity value of ₹180 Cr.
Subsidiary BNHOPL completed the acquisition of 100% stake in STEAG Energy Services (India).
STEAG Energy Services (India) won a 60-month comprehensive O&M contract for BALCO's 1,740 MW power plant, estimated aggregate value ₹2,049.8 Cr including additional services, from 1 July 2026.
STEAG won 4 large multi-year contracts contributing over ₹5,200 Cr to Bluspring's top line over next 5 years
LSG Sky Chefs clocked annual revenue of ₹112 Cr in FY26 with high teen EBITDA margins
Foundit recorded sales of ₹25 Cr in Q1FY27, converting to revenue of ₹19 Cr with EBITDA loss of ₹14 Cr

timeline.summary: On April 23, 2026, Bluspring Enterprises shareholders approved the 2026 Employee Stock Option Scheme, trust secondary acquisition, and funding via postal ballot.
Fairbridge Capital (Mauritius) Limited and HWIC Asia Fund (Class A Shares) declared no new encumbrances on Bluspring Enterprises Limited shares as of 02 April 2026.
Bluspring Enterprises' subsidiary BNHOPL entered into a ₹175 Cr term loan agreement with Poonawalla Fincorp to fund the acquisition of STEAG Energy Services (India).
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹864.8 Cr (+7.9% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹4.12 Cr (against a loss of ₹19.74 Cr a year earlier).
On May 19, 2026, Bluspring Enterprises reported FY26 revenue of ₹3,304 Cr, up 11% YoY, with Q4 EBITDA margins expanding by 105 bps YoY to 4.2%.
Bluspring Enterprises reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹865 Cr and announced the ₹180 Cr acquisition of STEAG Energy Services India.
Bluspring Enterprises Limited uploaded the audio recording of its May 20, 2026 analyst call on its website.
On May 21, 2026, Bluspring Enterprises completed the 100% acquisition of STEAG Energy Services (India) via its subsidiary BNHOPL.
On May 20, 2026, Bluspring Enterprises reported FY27 guidance of 15-16% organic revenue growth and announced near-term completion of the STEAG and LSG acquisitions.

On 5 June 2026, Bluspring's wholly-owned step-down subsidiary STEAG Energy Services (India) won a 60-month comprehensive O&M contract for BALCO's 1,740 MW power plant, estimated at ₹2,049.8 Cr, starting 1 July 2026.

Bluspring completed STEAG acquisition on May 21, 2026, with numbers consolidated from that date; in process of closing LSG Sky Chefs acquisition for ₹166 Cr; raised FY27 guidance to ₹4,700 Cr revenue (+42% YoY) and ₹200 Cr EBITDA (+65% YoY)

Bluspring Enterprises Limited schedules earnings conference call on un-audited Q2 & H1 FY27 results with **Kamal Pal Hoda (ED & CEO)**, **Prapul Sridhar (CFO)**, and **Nibodh Shetty (Head, Investor Relations)** on **November 7, 2026, at 10:30 AM IST**.
